column3: app_main init: FUN_fffd405e (menu UI state) then menu_init
Calls menu_build_all
Straight list of 314 BSRs to menuitem_* (registration order = table index)
Copy a 0x38-byte item descriptor into RAM table 0x2105C[0x15E]; append index to per-P1 list 0x1FA50+0xC8*P1 (counts 0x1B4F6..FB)
(P1, global P2): 1 if any item of that group exists for this destination
key {P1,P2,P3} -> table index via per-P1 list, honours dest_mask (+1); 0xFFFF if none
key -> copy of the 0x38-byte descriptor
key -> 21-char item name (desc+6)
Number of items in global P2 group (dest-filtered)
Number of P2 groups in a P1 group (dest-filtered)
key, buf -> desc.on_draw(buf) (+0x1C): encode value for the DISPLAY menu page
key -> desc.on_step() (+0x20): dial step, or apply hook when 0x15DFC=1 (CAT)
key -> desc.on_enter() (+0x24): action items (SD card, reset, calibration...)
(P1, local P2) -> global P2 index (bases 0,5,7,12,16,22)
Destination code -> item mask bit (1,2,4,8,0x10,0x20) compared with desc+1
Global P2 -> pointer to that group's {top,row} cursor
key -> 16 bytes desc+0x28..0x37 (min,max,store,flags)
(key, 0=read/1=write, u16*): byte or big-endian word at desc.store, or FM VFO accessor (desc+0x35 = 1/2/3)
menu_value_rw(key, 0, p)
menu_value_rw(key, 1, p)
(key, rw, buf, n): copy text item (MY CALL, PRESET NAME)
menu_string_rw(key, 0, buf, n)
menu_string_rw(key, 1, buf, n)
Set 0x15DFC=1, menu_call_step(key), clear, set state+0x40B (0x20F0F) refresh flag
Front panel: dial step on the selected row (timer 3000, sets 0x20F0F, menu_call_step)
Front panel: run the selected row's on_enter [inference]
Build the menu page for the DISPLAY (P1 title, P2 tabs, 5 rows of name+value) into frame 0x1741 at +0x98
on_draw helper: row flag byte (bit7 if arg==0, bit6 if row being edited 0x12271) + value
Generic signed stepper (min, max, ptr); no-op when 0x15DFC=1 (CAT apply); direction state+0x421
Generic unsigned stepper (min, max, ptr) [inference: unsigned twin of menu_step_s8]
EX010317 accessor: (VFO byte+2 >> 2) & 3
EX010317 accessor (set)
EX010320 accessor
EX010320 accessor (set)
EX010321 accessor
EX010321 accessor (set)
Reset menu value block 0x9A2A.. from ROM 0xFFF80E4A.. (callees below) + 0x9C17<-0xFFF80FD6
RADIO SETTING mode groups 0x9A2A..0x9A90 <- ROM
CW SETTING 0x9A91..0x9AB4 <- ROM 0xFFF80EB1
OPERATION SETTING 0x9AB5.. <- ROM 0xFFF80ED5, then dest-dependent MAX POWER, KEYBOARD LANGUAGE, TX TOT
DISPLAY SETTING 0x9B01.. <- ROM 0xFFF80F21
5 x PRESET block 0x9B2E+0x1F*n <- ROM 0xFFF80F4E; names FT-8, PRESET2..5
eeprom_write(0x53DB, 0x9A2A, 0x45C) + (0x1A62, 0x60B1, 0x18)
EX core: parse key, read or write, on set menu_apply_from_cat, copy reply 0x18878 -> 0x1C8E
Dispatch on is_set and desc string flag (+0x30)
Reply EXkkkkkk + 12-char text
Copy P4 text up to ";" (max 12) into the item
Format value: 1 digit, 2/3 digits (+sign), or 4 digits (u16 or scaled x10 / x20+20)
Check length/range, parse P4, unscale (/10 or /20-1), menu_value_set
Rejects EX010113 (SSB TX BPF SEL) value 5 (50-4000Hz)
Byte -> 2/3 decimal digits, or sign + 2 digits
u16 -> 4 decimal digits
4 decimal digits, range check [min,max]
1-3 digits with optional sign, exact length, range check
P1P1P2P2P3P3 (decimal) -> internal {P1-1, P2+base, P3-1}; CAT P1 05 and >06 rejected
